verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page bullet listing "Authentication" as a platform feature (mintlify-docs-60). An Enterprise bullet lists "SSO, SCIM & RBAC" (mintlify-docs-61), but it is unclear whether that SSO protects reader access to docs or only the dashboard. So the capability is claimed but barely documented. Missing for 10: docs describing password, JWT and SSO reader-auth methods; evidence of gating some pages versus the whole site; setup details; independent or hands-on corroboration.
